summary: SCOPE: Regression tests for the fixed bug in internal/codeintel/findImplementations (roles.go:128) which historically used NumExplicitMethods instead of NumMethods, silently returning no results for interfaces composed entirely of embedded methods. The production fix is already present (roles.go:128 uses iface.NumMethods()==0, analyzer.go:268 uses iface.NumMethods()>0). No existing test calls findImplementations end-to-end. The existing explicit_methods_test.go checks preconditions and calls types.Implements directly but never exercises findImplementations. FILES CHANGING: internal/codeintel/roles_test.go only (add 3 test functions). No production code changes. TEST PLAN (test-first order): (1) success case TestFindImplementationsEmbeddedInterface: type-check a package containing 'type WrappedReader interface { io.Reader }' (NumExplicitMethods==0, NumMethods==1) and 'type myReader struct{}' with Read method. Build packages.Package with non-nil Types, non-nil TypesInfo with populated Defs/Uses maps, and non-nil Fset to bypass the nil guard at roles.go:124 which checks (pkg==nil || pkg.Types==nil || pkg.TypesInfo==nil || targetObj==nil). Call findImplementations targeting WrappedReader and assert addLoc fires at least once for myReader. Uses importer.For("compiler", nil) for CGo-free CI portability (acknowledged inconsistency with existing tests using importer.Default()). (2) negative case TestFindImplementationsEmptyInterfaceReturnsNone: type-check 'type Empty interface {}' (NumMethods==0), call findImplementations targeting Empty, assert addLoc is never called. Confirms roles.go:128 guard correctly skips truly empty interfaces. (3) negative case TestFindImplementationsNilInputs: call findImplementations with nil pkg, nil targetObj, and pkg with nil Types/nil TypesInfo in three subtests. Assert addLoc is never called. Confirms roles.go:124 nil guard returns early safely. SECURITY: No secrets, no file-path manipulation, no external input. findImplementations only reads go/types metadata from an in-process type-checked package. No new attack surface. FUZZ: Not practical -- findImplementations operates on go/types objects requiring a full type-check of syntactically valid Go source. Generating bounded valid packages for fuzzing is infeasible; the function has no raw byte input. HOST EVIDENCE GATES: (1) go test ./internal/codeintel/... -count=1 -race, (2) go vet ./internal/codeintel/..., (3) verify no new TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX in changed files.
